# Globe dependencies and geographic data

- D3 7.9.0 — ISC license, copyright Mike Bostock. https://github.com/d3/d3
- topojson-client 3.1.0 — ISC license, copyright Mike Bostock. https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client
- world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-50m — ISC package; derived from public-domain Natural Earth boundaries. https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas and https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

The geographic boundaries provide a visual index, not banking data or an endorsement of territorial claims. Financial values come exclusively from the active uploaded dataset. Dependencies are pinned and served locally.
